chunk.text: Instant Cover Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Policy, by choosing this Optional Benefit the Company shall waive off the applicable PED waiting period on Diabetes/ Hypertension/ Hyperlipidemia/ Asthma at the time of issuance of first Policy with the Company. Note: The above Optional Benefit can be opted only if this policy is issued for the first time with the Company and on continues renewal without break in policy. Deductible If this Optional Benefit is opted, then Policyholder is entitled for a discount on the Premium payable. The claim amount assessed by the Company for a particular claim shall be reduced by the Deductible as specified in the Policy Schedule and the Company shall be liable to make payment under the Policy for any Claim only when the Deductible on that Claim is exhausted.

Indemnity/Indemnify means compensating the Insured Person up to the extent of Expenses incurred, on occurrence of an event which results in a financial loss and is covered as the subject matter of the Insurance Cover. Insured Event means an event that is covered under the Policy; and which is in accordance with the Policy Terms & Conditions. Insured Person (Insured) means a self, legally married spouse, dependent children, dependent parents or any other relationship having an insurable interest and whose name specifically appears under Insured in the Policy Schedule and with respect to whom the premium has been received by the Company.

chunk.text: Notwithstanding anything contained herein or otherwise, no refunds of premium shall be made in respect of Cancellation where, any claim has been admitted or has been lodged or any benefit has been availed by the Insured Person under the Policy The Company may cancel the Policy at any time on grounds of mis-representations, non-disclosure of material facts, fraud by the Insured Person, by giving 15 days' written notice. There would be no refund of premium on cancellation on grounds of mis-representations, non-disclosure of material facts or fraud. Notes: In case of demise of the Policyholder, Where the Policy covers only the Policyholder, this Policy shall stand null and void from the date and time of demise of the Policyholder. The premium would be refunded for t0he unexpired period of this Policy at the short period scales subject to no claim has been admitted or has been lodged or any benefit has been availed by the Insured Person under the Policy.

appeal_draft:
To,
The Grievance Officer / Claims Review Committee

Subject: Request for clarification on the rejection of my health insurance claim
Policy: [policy number]   Claim: CLM-59823   Date of rejection: [date of rejection]

Facts:
  - We regret to inform you that the claim for the donor's medical expenses, referenced in CLM-59823, is not covered under your policy.
  - The clause does not specify if the claim is for a covered condition. It only outlines optional benefits and deductibles.

Policy wording relied on:
  - Clause care_supreme-0051: "Instant Cover Notwithstanding anything to the contrary in the Policy, by choosing this Optional Benefit the Company shall waive off the applicable PED waiting period on Diabetes/ Hypertension/ Hyperlipidemia/ Asthma at the time of issuance of first Policy with the Company."
  - Clause care_supreme-0051: "The claim amount assessed by the Company for a particular claim shall be reduced by the Deductible as specified in the Policy Schedule and the Company shall be liable to make payment under the Policy for any Claim only when the Deductible on that Claim is exhausted."

Reasoning:
  The clause does not clarify whether the donor's medical expenses fall under any covered conditions, and it only discusses optional benefits and deductibles.

Relief sought:
  We kindly request the insurer to clarify the ground for rejection and confirm whether the donor's medical expenses are covered under the policy.

Documents to attach:
  - Copy of the claim rejection letter
  - Policy wording and policy schedule
  - Claim form and discharge summary
  - Medical bills, prescriptions and investigation reports
  - Earlier correspondence with the insurer, including any grievance acknowledgement
  - Identity proof of the policyholder

Yours faithfully,
[policyholder name]

Note on timing: A complaint to the Insurance Ombudsman needs a written representation to the insurer first; it must then be made within one year of the insurer's rejection, or of one month after the representation was sent (Insurance Ombudsman Rules, 2017, Rule 14(3), checked against the published text as amended till 09.11.2023; later amendments not checked). Confirm with the Ombudsman office before relying on a date, and compute dates with the deadline tool.

---
